source: AI Image Skill Catalog - quality rubrics and delivery specifications

dimensions.label: Composition
dimensions.description: Balance, focal clarity, rule-of-thirds alignment, edge tension.

dimensions.label: Exposure
dimensions.description: Histogram distribution, clipping in shadows and highlights.

dimensions.label: Contrast
dimensions.description: Tonal separation between subject and ground.

dimensions.label: Colour
dimensions.description: Saturation distribution, palette coherence, no channel clipping.

dimensions.label: Sharpness
dimensions.description: Edge energy and focus; blur detection.

dimensions.label: Noise
dimensions.description: Sensor or compression noise versus intentional grain.

dimensions.label: Artefacts
dimensions.description: Banding, blocking, tiling seams, halos, duplicates.

dimensions.label: Resolution fit
dimensions.description: Sufficient pixels for the intended delivery size.

bands.label: Revise
bands.action: Target the two lowest dimensions and re-render.

bands.label: Reject
bands.action: Re-render from the prompt, not from a rescue edit.

artifact_checks.label: Gradient banding
artifact_checks.method: detect contour steps in smooth luminance ramps

artifact_checks.label: Tiling seam
artifact_checks.method: detect periodic discontinuity at 512 px intervals

artifact_checks.label: Edge halo
artifact_checks.method: detect bright rim around high-contrast subject boundaries

artifact_checks.label: Duplicated region
artifact_checks.method: detect horizontally or vertically repeated blocks

artifact_checks.label: Flat / dead region
artifact_checks.method: detect large areas with near-zero variance

artifact_checks.label: Channel clipping
artifact_checks.method: measure pure black and pure white pixel share

artifact_checks.label: Unexpected aspect
artifact_checks.method: compare rendered aspect to the requested aspect

adherence_checks.label: Requested text is legible and exact
No blocking artefacts in key regions

web.note: Strip metadata on public web delivery.

social.note: Keep the focal point inside the platform crop.

print.note: Supply bleed and keep the safe area 5 mm inside the trim.

email.note: Inline images must stay under 2 MB.

rules: no spaces, no parentheses, no diacritics
include the campaign or SKU identifier
include the seed when the asset must be reproducible

print.viewing_distance_rule: characters should be roughly 1/30 of the viewing distance in mm
